title: One forge module answers merge request and pipeline state for land, merge, red-pipeline and stalled, with a glab arm and a gh arm
goal: _tools/bl_forge.py is the one place that reads a forge: merge request state by title prefix or branch (merged, opened with its pipeline status and detailed merge status, closed), the newest pipeline of a ref, and merge of the item's own request; land, merge, red-pipeline, selfcheck's main check and stalled call it and nothing else runs glab; backlog.json names the forge (gitlab with glab, github with gh) and the project; a read happens once per land pass, and land --wait-merge sleeps and re-reads at its long interval, never a loop a session writes; stalled gains mr-dead (pipeline failed, canceled, skipped or manual, or merge blocked: none of these becomes merged by waiting). The gh arm is tested on recorded fixtures only.
links: memory: GitHub is the kb's public home, gitlab.com the private dev and CI; a gh arm serves the publish side later
notes: Merged from BG-iq52pvdl “forge_project is half-honoured: land lists merge requests by the remote URL's project but reads and rewrites descriptions by the setting's” at the 2026-10-10 backlog triage: Premise holds: bl_land.py:814 and :2035 read forge_project, ql_deliver.forge_list:77 re-derives the project from the URL, and bl_intake.py has no forge_project. The single forge module of ST-4jjz3vxs removes the split by construction; the repro (forge_project absent from bl_intake.py) still fails. Its goal: With backlog.json forge_project set, every forge call of land, merge, red-pipeline and ql_deliver uses the same project: forge_list (ql_deliver.py:77) re-derives the project from the URL while read_merge_request and the description PUT (bl_land.py:796) use the setting, so a wrong request's description can be overwritten; bl_intake.py:1199 and ql_deliver ignore it. Found by the SP-befc6yqr review (S2 of ST-qgnjxiol). Its touches: _tools/bl_land.py, _tools/ql_deliver.py, _tools/bl_intake.py, kb/_self/backlog.md
